instruction: I visit this page often. Can you make a quick access shortcut on my desktop using the browser's shortcut creation feature?

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to create a desktop shortcut for Wikipedia homepage using Chrome's built-in shortcut feature. Similar complexity to original task - single website, single action required. The app-id is different for Wikipedia (mhlonobefdilfijeamckflfnnnneegei) compared to the 2048 game. Verified that existing evaluator functions (get_shortcuts_on_desktop and is_shortcut_on_desktop) can handle this task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts desktop shortcuts by reading .desktop files on Linux
Metric logic correctly checks for the Exec= line in the shortcut file content
Expected app-id (mhlonobefdilfijeamckflfnnnneegei) appears to be deterministic for Wikipedia based on metadata verification
Evaluator can semantically verify that a Chrome desktop shortcut for Wikipedia was created
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider relaxing the exact match requirement to allow for variations in Chrome flags or profile directory names
The evaluator assumes Chrome generates the same app-id for Wikipedia across all systems - this assumption should be explicitly documented or verified
Consider adding URL verification as a secondary check to ensure the shortcut points to Wikipedia (not just matching the app-id)
